name: RETORT AUTOCLAVE
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-RXAU-110 Retort Autoclave is a heavy-duty, horizontal industrial sterilizer specifically engineered for the rigorous demands of the food processing and packaging industries. Designed to provide optimal food preservation by eliminating harmful bacteria, it effectively sterilizes retort pouches, cans, and liquid-filled containers.
features: Horizontal Cylindrical design insulated with Aluminum Silicate
Stainless Steel 304 / 316 OR Carbon Steel material construction
Microprocessor Based Controller managing semi-automatic operations
Maximum Working Temperature of 121°C at 0.3 Mpa / 43.5 Psi
Mechanical Lock with high-temperature Silicone Rubber Seal

specifications.Target Applications: Food Preservation, Retort Pouches, Canned Foods, Mushroom Cultivation
